mentions.name: Opticsketch
mentions.description: This app is a 3D optics simulator that lets users model optical systems with components like lenses and mirrors, offering a quick but realistic alternative to expensive commercial optics software.
mentions.problem: Commercial optical-system modeling software costs a few thousand dollars; the author needed a quick but realistic way to model optical systems without that expense.
mentions.audience: I sometimes need to have a quick but realistic model of an optical system without paying a few thousand for some of the well known commercial offerings
mentions.author: opticsketch

mentions.name: Optic Sketch
mentions.description: Optic Sketch is a 3D optical simulator for building quick but realistic models of optical systems, provided as a free alternative to commercial optical design offerings that cost thousands.
mentions.problem: Well-known commercial optical simulation software costs a few thousand, but the author sometimes needs a quick yet realistic model of an optical system without paying that much.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A 3D optical simulator called Optic Sketch - https://opticsketch.github.io/opticsketch/.

I sometimes need to have a quick but realistic model of an optical system without paying a few thousand for some of the well known commercial offerings, so I've been building this.
